method: Interior original 5600-row `artifact_tool` import; NFKD exact normalised names repeated across election dates 20-34 years apart and province changed; 17 labels fit, first 8 by temporal span descending then alphabetical fixed before official searches; audited exact fixed eight.

cases.name: José María Benegas Haddad
cases.basis: Congress fiche lists Constituyente, I, II, IV–X, birth 1948 and official term history, including 2011.

cases.name: Mariano Rajoy Brey
cases.basis: Congress fiche lists III–XII legislatures and 1955 DOB; continuity as party and province change.

cases.name: José Bono Martínez
cases.basis: Congress Presidency biography explicitly lists election by Albacete 1979 and 1982 and presidency of Congress 2008-2011 as same individual.

cases.name: Josep Antoni Duran i Lleida
cases.basis: Congress fiches 1982 Lérida vs 2008 Barcelona share DOB 1952-03-27 and II/III/IV/VIII/IX/X cross-links.

cases.name: Gabriel Cisneros Laborda
cases.basis: Official Congreso biography expressly narrates Soria 1977–1986, Burgos 1989–2000 and Zaragoza 2000–2007 as same politician.

cases.name: Cristina Narbona Ruiz
cases.basis: Congress official profile lists VI,VIII,IX,X,XV, and ministerial service, tying 1996 Almería with 2023 Madrid as same individual. Official Moncloa 2008 biography lists both 1996 Almería and 2004/2008 Madrid.
cases.contradiction: Congress dob 1951-07-29; Moncloa ministerial 2008 dob 1951-07-21; cannot treat mismatch as proof of homonym

cases.name: Ramón Aguirre Rodríguez
cases.basis: Congress IV/V/VI Cáceres and XII Guadalajara profiles same 1953-03-03 DOB, list IV,V,VI,VII,IX,X,XII.

cases.name: Francisco Miguel Fernández Marugán
cases.basis: Congress II Sevilla profile lists term II–IX and birth 1946-10-06; VIII official memory lists same person Badajoz, previous terms II–VII.

hypothesis_results.H1: NOT FOUND: no true exact-name different-person homonym in preselected sample
hypothesis_results.H0: Eight positive continuities documented by source-maintained parliamentary biographies and birth information; no population false-match rate inferred

new_epistemic_failure: Conflicting official date-of-birth for same securely linked politician discovered; flagged for independent triangulation C17, not silently reconciled
limits: Follow-up subject sample selected after initial C15, with first eight fixed before verification and no blind test
Institutional historic bios are maintained in 2026 and not contemporaneously visible in older elections; as-of eligibility not automatically established
Some long-spanning political careers are well-known; positive-only sample selection is adversarially weak for homonym negatives.
No immutable universal identity keys in Interior XLSX; the external source links are bounded to observed historical legislatures.
